feed.title: DevCentr News
feed.subtitle: Shipped work, partnerships, and openings from Dev-Centr.

entry.title: A Control Panel for all Config file types
entry.summary: UniConfig Config Panel opens INI, YAML, TOML, SDLang, and tfvars with schema-backed settings widgets — including fields the file never mentioned.

entry.title: New additions to the Business Bootstrap guide
entry.summary: Scheduling, design, and vault capability areas land in Business Bootstrap on docs.devcentr.org.

entry.title: MSI-generator v0.2 released
entry.summary: msi-generator v0.2 writes real OLE2 compound files, cabinets, and core Windows Installer tables — still unsigned, no longer an empty stub.

entry.title: DevCentr’s new install tool, Ibex, released
entry.summary: Ibex (Install Builder EXtension): CLI and Explorer actions for installer projects, in-place PATH installs, and CI pipeline emit.

entry.title: Partnership with OpenShellOrg
entry.summary: DevCentr and OpenShellOrg lock the sibling story: toolchain ownership here, shell entrypoint honesty there.

entry.title: News desk opens
entry.summary: DevCentr opens a public News feed for shipped work and partnerships — not a dump of every docs edit.

entry.title: Help hub opens beside the docs
entry.summary: A Help hub lands so "I need assistance" no longer means "go read the manual."

entry.title: Brand mark stays in open SVG
entry.summary: The DevCentr mark ships as open SVG motion — not a proprietary player dependency for an open brand.
